Author: Legends of the Game
Name: Time Memoria
Description: Quest progression and pacing — a reflective notebook for your story journey, not a scoreboard.
Punchline: Remember every step, Warriors of Light.
Changelog:
Collections, the bestiary and optional features.
Exports:
- The Ledger export is about half its former size (fmt 2), so it pastes cheaply into other tools. Master recipe books are added.
- New collections export (/tm collections, Copy collections): mounts, minions, orchestrion rolls, Triple Triad cards and NPCs, emotes, fashion accessories, facewear, curiosities, fish, spearfish, Master's Bestiary captures and folklore tomes read.
- World lists in the collections export: sightseeing log, aether currents, aetherytes and porter stops, plus the game client build.
- New full export (/tm full, Copy everything): progress and collections together.
- Quests done, duty clears and quest totals by expansion, so the Ledger can show questlines and a duty grid.
- Mount speed per zone and bicolor gemstones.
Features:
- New Features list in Settings. Each feature is optional and off until you turn it on.
- Master's Bestiary: every Beastmaster beast, where to tame it, the minimum level, the Kornago Gourd, and whether you have captured it. Click Flag to open the map there.
- /bmap turns the Master's Bestiary on and opens it beside the game's own Master's Bestiary. It replaces the Bestiary Mapper plugin.
Fixes:
- Active Events no longer lists an event twice when its name has an apostrophe.
- Levequest folders use the game's job names.
